watch.kill_criterion: Fade thesis invalid if ANY of these occur within 10 trading days: (1) memory_storage score rises back above 1.3; (2) durability_bar crosses above 0.6; (3) breadth becomes >0 (i.e., new constituents join the trend); (4) r10 turns positive. Those would indicate a re-acceleration, not a continuation of the fade. Conversely, confirmation signs: score drops below 1.0, durability_bar stays ≤0.5, breadth stays 0, and challenger(s) narrow the margin to <0.15.

Guardrails forbid next-theme prediction, so this is only a watch on the current leader's deterioration.
